note: Rows rank the routes for each user-experience job, starting at 1. Rank 0, the project's own research, personas, analytics and tools, is one rule in the skills and never a row. A kind skill id is its slash invocation without arguments: /plugin:skill, or /skill for a standalone skill. On a kind plugin row or a /plugin:skill row, a bare detect means this plugin's own marketplace; on any other row it names a skill directory, an MCP server or a tool; any other plugin detect names its marketplace as name@marketplace. A row for one of this marketplace's own skills carries no pointer; every other row does. The routing-as-data convention (docs/conventions/routing-as-data) defines these rules.
